meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 装上后,你让 Claude 把某个 NanoClaw 智能体组切到本地 Ollama 时,它会调整配置并重启服务,让该组改用本地模型,不再依赖 Anthropic 的在线接口。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在本地电脑运行、省下 API 费用,或试用开放权重模型时触发。执行中会确认用哪个智能体组、哪个本地模型,以及是否禁止访问 Anthropic 在线接口。

say.text: 把这个智能体组接到本地 Ollama 模型上
say.note: 技能会确认用哪个组、哪个模型。

say.text: 把这个智能体组切回 Anthropic 在线接口
say.note: 会移除相应的本地配置,无需重新构建。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model. Claude updates the configuration and restarts the service so the group uses the local model instead of relying on Anthropic's online API.
howto.when_en: It is used when you want an agent to run locally, save API costs, or try open-weight models. During setup it asks which agent group, which local model, and whether to block the Anthropic online API.

say_en.text: Point this agent group at a local Ollama model
say_en.note: It first asks which group and model to use.

say_en.text: Point the demo group at qwen3-coder and block the Anthropic API
say_en.note: It updates container config and settings, then restarts.

say_en.text: Switch this agent group back to the Anthropic API
say_en.note: It removes the local overrides and model setting; no rebuild needed.
